Direction: three-quarter side view, face and attack point to viewer's RIGHT in EVERY cell.

top-right TELEGRAPH: wings clearly raised HIGH above its ears, compact body pulling back, focused harmless expression; visibly preparing to flap forward.
bottom-left ATTACK: wings sweep DOWN and forward, torso tilts slightly toward RIGHT, small compact curved air strokes close to wing tips, no projectile or huge effect.
bottom-right CURSE RELEASE: still intact and floating, shoulders/wings relaxed and half-folded, eyes gently closed, happy tiny smile, three tiny warm sparkles close to its body. No falling, injury, threatening face or frightening teeth.
STRICT LAYOUT: Each complete bat including wing tips, ears, feet, air strokes and sparkles MUST stay within the central45% width and central45% height of its own cell. Entire silhouette fully inside each cell. Plenty of empty canvas; do not enlarge figures to fill it.
Actual transparent RGBA, not a checkerboard picture. No background, floor, shadow, grid, text, labels, numbers, logos, signature, watermark, music notes, hearts, blood, wounds, torn wings, religious symbols or additional creatures. Warm, readable child-friendly webtoon art; lavender bat palette remains distinct from teal environment.
